item.title: Bags from the public litter bin dumped in the edge of the woodland, 9th November
item.description:
There is a public litter bin on the corner that is often overflowing, it seems that council workers have emptied it and put a new liner in it and have then dumped 2 full bin liners of rubbish from the public litter bin on the tree line of the pavement instead of taking them away. This is unacceptable! People try do the right thing by desposing of their litter in the bin only for the council themselves to dump it in the floor ready for it to get ripped open by foxes and rats adding to an already overly littered area. Absolutely disgusting! Bromley council, you are failing miserably. The amount of litter in this area has been getting worse for years now with no signs of improvement. When are you going to do what you are being paid by hard working tax payers to do?!
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sevenoaks Way, St Paul's Cray, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
